name: Afraid Falcon 17
author: vinodjangid07
description: Pill light indigo button that lifts on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, width becomes 140px, border-radius becomes 50px, background-color changes from #141414 to #b5a0ff.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Afraid Falcon 17</title>
<style>
/* Afraid Falcon 17 by vinodjangid07 — https://uiverse.io/vinodjangid07/afraid-falcon-17 */
.button {
  width: 50px;
  height: 50px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: rgb(20, 20, 20);
  border: none;
  font-weight: 600;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  box-shadow: 0px 0px 0px 4px rgba(180, 160, 255, 0.253);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition-duration: 0.3s;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
}

.svgIcon {
  width: 12px;
  transition-duration: 0.3s;
}

.svgIcon path {
  fill: white;
}

.button:hover {
  width: 140px;
  border-radius: 50px;
  transition-duration: 0.3s;
  background-color: rgb(181, 160, 255);
  align-items: center;
}

.button:hover .svgIcon {

  transition-duration: 0.3s;
  transform: translateY(-200%);
}

.button::before {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -20px;
  content: "Back to Top";
  color: white;

  font-size: 0px;
}

.button:hover::before {
  font-size: 13px;
  opacity: 1;
  bottom: unset;

  transition-duration: 0.3s;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">
  <svg class="svgIcon" viewBox="0 0 384 512">
    <path
      d="M214.6 41.4c-12.5-12.5-32.8-12.5-45.3 0l-160 160c-12.5 12.5-12.5 32.8 0 45.3s32.8 12.5 45.3 0L160 141.2V448c0 17.7 14.3 32 32 32s32-14.3 32-32V141.2L329.4 246.6c12.5 12.5 32.8 12.5 45.3 0s12.5-32.8 0-45.3l-160-160z"
    ></path>
  </svg>
</button>

</body>
</html>
